title: Mahābhārata
description: The principal Sanskrit epic of the Hindu tradition, comprising approximately 100,000 śloka couplets. Names the *Vedas* and *Rāmāyaṇa* within its broader textual corpus. Listed in the *Yes... I am Raelian* commentary as carrying 'traces' of the Elohim contact.

cited_by.title: Reference corpus of the Raëlian canon
